items.title: Deployments now show build cache size
items.summary: Deployment summaries now show the size of the build cache each deployment saved and how close it is to the limit for its . The same information is in the CLI with  on version 65.1.0 or newer, and in the .build machineget-deployment REST API endpointvercel inspectUploading the build cache is billable build time, and a cache that goes over the limit is discarded, so the next build starts without one.
